name: prowl-dev
description: Development checks for the Prowl page, worker and extension. Nothing here ships: the page is one file pasted into Shopify, the worker deploys from worker/.

scripts.lint: node scripts/check-page.mjs && mkdir -p /tmp/prowl-w && cp worker/*.js /tmp/prowl-w/ && echo '{"type":"module"}' > /tmp/prowl-w/package.json && for f in /tmp/prowl-w/*.js extension/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
